nodes.answer: Spatial Differentiation was identified as a key theme in rural areas, highlighting the impact of spatial conditions on the environment and societal features.

nodes.question: How do stakeholders in Greek rural areas perceive the issue of spatial differentiation and its impact on land use and management systems?
nodes.answer: Stakeholders in Greek rural areas view spatial differentiation as a key topic for discussion due to the continuously changing slope and its visual impact on the landscape resulting from land uses and management systems.
